simple.prompt: Reporting reporting verb + infinitive: 'He ___ to assist us with the financial restructuring.'
simple.explanation: Pola verb pattern: agree + to-infinitive ('agreed to assist'). 'Said' dan 'told' tidak bisa langsung diikuti to-infinitive tanpa objek/that.

simple.prompt: Reporting with gerund: 'The suspect admitted ___ the luxury sedan.'
simple.explanation: Pola verb: admit + Gerund / V-ing ('admit stealing').
hints: Kata kerja 'admit' diikuti oleh bentuk gerund (-ing).

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat reported speech dengan 'encouraged him to'.
simple.targetSentence: The mentor encouraged him to pursue higher education.
simple.explanation: Subject + encouraged + object (him) + to pursue higher education.

simple.prompt: Tense backshift: 'I am resigning tomorrow' -> He announced that he ___ the following day.
simple.explanation: Present continuous 'am resigning' bergeser mundur (backshift) menjadi Past continuous 'was resigning'.
hints: Backshift dari Present Continuous ke Past Continuous.

simple.targetSentence: She apologized for arriving late to the seminar.
simple.explanation: Subject + apologized for + arriving late to the seminar.

simple.prompt: Reporting orders: 'The officer ordered the suspects ___ their hands.'
simple.explanation: Order + someone + to-infinitive: 'ordered the suspects to raise their hands'.

simple.targetSentence: The guard warned us not to touch the exhibit.
simple.explanation: The guard + warned us + not to touch the exhibit.
hints: Negatif infinitive: 'not to touch the exhibit'.

simple.prompt: Maya denied ___ any confidential client numbers to external contractors.
simple.explanation: Reporting verb 'deny' wajib diikuti gerund (V-ing) atau that-clause, bukan to-infinitive.

simple.prompt: The safety officer reminded all lab assistants ___ their protective visors before entering.
simple.explanation: Pola 'remind + someone + to + V1' wajib menyertakan objek orang dan to-infinitive.
hints: Setelah objek 'all lab assistants', gunakan to-infinitive.

simple.prompt: Our mentor advised ___ a concise outline before drafting the twenty-page thesis.
simple.explanation: Tanpa objek manusia di belakangnya, 'advise' langsung diikuti gerund ('advise writing'); jika memakai objek orang, barulah 'advise someone to write'.
hints: Tidak ada objek orang tepat setelah 'advised'.

simple.prompt: The vendor apologized ___ delivering the acoustic panels two days behind schedule.
simple.explanation: Pasangan preposisi tetap untuk 'apologize' sebelum gerund/noun adalah 'for' ('apologize for + V-ing').

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang pelaporan janji dengan reporting verb yang presisi.
dialogue: What did the cloud provider guarantee in writing?
They ___ to compensate any downtime exceeding ten minutes.
simple.explanation: Hanya 'promise' yang dapat diikuti langsung oleh to-infinitive ('promised to compensate'); 'suggest' dan 'insist' tidak memakai to-infinitive.
hints: Lihat 'to compensate' tepat di belakang rumpang.

simple.prompt: The coordinator accused the freight agency ___ misplacing three priority crates.
simple.explanation: Pola baku 'accuse' adalah 'accuse + someone + of + V-ing'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan struktur verb pelapor 'insist' pada kalimat berikut.
simple.draft: Our project lead insisted to double-check every formula prior to publication.
options: Our project lead insisted on double-checking every formula prior to publication.
Our project lead insisted us to double-check every formula prior to publication.
Our project lead insisted double-check every formula prior to publication.
simple.explanation: 'Insist' tidak memakai to-infinitive ('insist to...'); pola yang tepat adalah 'insist on + V-ing' atau 'insist that + S + verb'.

simple.prompt: She congratulated her junior partner ___ securing the regional sustainability grant.
simple.explanation: Ungkapan selamat resmi memakai 'congratulate + someone + on + V-ing' (atau 'for' dalam ragam ringan; opsi baku tes adalah 'on').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat laporan memakai 'warn + someone + not to + V1'.
simple.targetSentence: The harbor master warned boaters not to cross the channel during high tide.
simple.explanation: Peringatan negatif memakai 'warned + objek + not to + V1'.
hints: Awali dengan 'The harbor master warned boaters'.
Tambahkan larangan 'not to cross the channel during high tide'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat laporan penyesalan dengan 'regret + V-ing'.
simple.targetSentence: He later regretted rejecting the collaborative fellowship in Oslo.
simple.explanation: Menyesali keputusan lampau memakai 'regret + V-ing' ('regretted rejecting').

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog reported speech tanpa backshift (universal truth / still true).
dialogue: Our physics teacher explained that water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.
intermediate.explanation: Ketika pernyataan berupa hukum alam, fakta ilmiah abadi, atau kebenaran umum yang tetap berlaku (timeless truth), tense TIDAK perlu di-backshift: 'boils'.

intermediate.prompt: Reporting suggestions: 'Dr. Lee suggested ___ the experimental drug dosage.'
intermediate.explanation: Pola baku: suggest + V-ing ATAU suggest + that + subject + (should) base verb. 'Suggest to reduce' atau 'suggest us to' adalah kesalahan umum.

intermediate.prompt: Subjunctive with suggest: 'The auditor suggested that the company ___ its accounting practices.'
intermediate.explanation: Dalam klausa 'suggest that...', bahasa Inggris baku menggunakan Mandative Subjunctive (kata kerja dasar tanpa -s/ed): 'revise'.
hints: Mandative Subjunctive menggunakan bentuk dasar kata kerja.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat reported speech dengan 'denied taking'.
intermediate.targetSentence: The suspect firmly denied taking the confidential documents.
intermediate.explanation: The suspect firmly denied + taking the confidential documents.

intermediate.prompt: Time marker transformation: 'yesterday' in direct speech changes to '___' in indirect speech.
options: the day before / the previous day
intermediate.explanation: Keterangan waktu 'yesterday' berubah menjadi 'the day before' atau 'the previous day'.
hints: Gunakan 'the day before' atau 'the previous day'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat mandative subjunctive dengan 'insisted that'.
intermediate.targetSentence: The director insisted that all staff members attend the meeting.
intermediate.explanation: The director insisted that + all staff members attend (subjunctive base) + the meeting.
hints: Bentuk dasar subjunctive: 'all staff members attend the meeting'.

dialogue: Did the spokesperson confirm the allegations?
No, she categorically denied ___ any involvement whatsoever.
intermediate.explanation: Deny + gerund (having / having had): 'denied having any involvement'.

intermediate.prompt: In formal policy recommendations, which verb triggers the Mandative Subjunctive ('that + subject + bare verb')?
options: recommended that every contract be audited
recommended us to audit every contract
recommended that every contract is been audited
intermediate.explanation: 'Recommend', 'suggest', 'propose', dan 'demand' + 'that' mewajibkan kata kerja dasar tanpa konjugasi ('be', bukan 'is/was') dalam bahasa formal (dan tidak boleh 'recommend + sb + to V1').
hints: Subjunctive sesudah 'recommended that...' memakai bare infinitive 'be'.

intermediate.prompt: The physics professor reminded students that sound waves ___ faster through steel than through air.
intermediate.explanation: Hukum alam atau fakta ilmiah universal ('sound waves travel faster through steel...') mempertahankan Present Simple meskipun reporting verb berbentuk lampau ('reminded').
hints: Ini adalah fakta fisika yang selalu berlaku sepanjang masa.
Fakta ilmiah permanen tidak perlu mengalami backshift.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog tentang pelaporan informasi yang masih relevan saat ini.
dialogue: Wait — didn't Dani text earlier today saying he is staying in Bandung until Friday?
Yes, he texted at nine that he ___ in Bandung all week, and today is only Tuesday.
intermediate.explanation: Karena rencana tinggal di Bandung sampai Jumat masih berlangsung sekarang ('today is only Tuesday'), bahasa Inggris modern mempertahankan Present Continuous ('is staying') demi menjaga relevansi kini.
hints: Hari ini baru Selasa, jadi informasi itu masih aktif berlaku.
Current relevance membolehkan tanpa backshift ('is staying').

intermediate.prompt: Choose the accurate reported form of: 'If you had locked the cabinet, the files would be safe.'
options: She pointed out that if we had locked the cabinet, the files would be safe.
She pointed out that if we would lock the cabinet, the files will be safe.
She pointed out that if we locked the cabinet, the files had been safe.
intermediate.explanation: Second/Third/Mixed Conditional dalam ucapan asli SUDAH berada di bentuk mundur terjauh, sehingga tidak berubah lagi dalam reported speech.
hints: Conditional Tipe 2, 3, dan Mixed tidak mengalami backshift lebih lanjut.

intermediate.prompt: The attorney ___ having altered any clause in the final annex.
intermediate.explanation: Verb yang langsung diikuti Perfect Gerund ('having altered') dan bermakna membantah tuduhan adalah 'denied' ('refused' dan 'promised' memakai to-infinitive).
hints: Perhatikan bentuk '-ing' ('having altered') tepat di belakang rumpang.
Hanya 'denied' cocok secara makna dan struktur gerund.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan reporting verb 'suggest' yang sering disalahgunakan dengan objek orang berikut.
intermediate.draft: My academic supervisor suggested me to submit the abstract before the early-bird deadline.
options: My academic supervisor suggested that I submit the abstract before the early-bird deadline.
My academic supervisor suggested me submitting the abstract before the early-bird deadline.
My academic supervisor suggested to me submit the abstract before the early-bird deadline.
intermediate.explanation: 'Suggest' TIDAK boleh diikuti objek orang + to-infinitive ('suggested me to...'); gunakan 'suggested that I submit...' (subjunctive) atau 'suggested submitting...'.
hints: 'Suggest' melarang keras pola 'verb + orang + to V1'.

intermediate.prompt: Direct: 'I must finish this blueprint tonight.' → Reported two weeks later: She said she ___ finish that blueprint that night.
intermediate.explanation: Ketika melaporkan kewajiban masa lalu yang sudah lewat dua minggu, 'must' bergeser ke bentuk lampau 'had to'.
hints: Kewajiban tersebut terjadi dua minggu lalu.

intermediate.prompt: Direct: 'You may leave once the scanner finishes.' → Reported: The technician told us that we ___ leave once the scanner finished.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam backshift standar dengan reporting verb lampau ('told'), 'may' mundur menjadi 'might' dan 'finishes' menjadi 'finished'.
hints: Kedua klausa dimundurkan ke bentuk lampau.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pelaporan formal memakai Mandative Subjunctive.
intermediate.targetSentence: The audit board insisted that every overseas invoice include a verified tax code.
intermediate.explanation: 'Insisted that + Subject + V1 (include)' menggunakan bare infinitive tanpa -s meski subjeknya tunggal ('invoice').
hints: Awali dengan 'The audit board insisted that every overseas invoice'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat laporan tanpa backshift untuk kebenaran umum.
intermediate.targetSentence: Our marine biologist noted that coral reefs shelter roughly a quarter of ocean species.
intermediate.explanation: Fakta ilmiah permanen tetap mempertahankan Present Simple 'shelter' setelah 'noted that'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Our marine biologist noted that coral reefs'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan umum penggunaan 'suggest to someone'.
complex.draft: The financial advisor suggested me to invest in sovereign bonds.
options: The financial advisor suggested that I invest in sovereign bonds.
The financial advisor suggested me investing in sovereign bonds.
The financial advisor suggested to me to invest in sovereign bonds.
complex.explanation: Kata kerja 'suggest' TIDAK PERNAH mengambil pola 'suggest someone to do something'. Pola yang tepat: 'suggest that someone (should) do something' atau 'suggest doing'.
hints: Gunakan pola subjunctive: 'suggested that I invest'.

complex.prompt: Nuance in backshift retention: When the reported statement remains immediately relevant and true right now:
options: Backshift is optional; the speaker may retain the present tense to signal current relevance.
Backshift is strictly mandatory in all circumstances without exception.
complex.explanation: Jika informasi yang dilaporkan masih relevan atau benar saat percakapan terjadi ('Jane told me she is pregnant'), mempertahankan present tense menandakan validitas masa kini.
hints: Relevansi situasi masih nyata saat ini.
Backshift bersifat opsional untuk menegaskan status terkini.

complex.prompt: Formal register with reporting verbs: 'The committee ___ the board to proceed with the tender.'
complex.explanation: Pola: urge + object + to-infinitive ('urged the board to proceed').

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat komplain reported speech dengan preposisi.
complex.targetSentence: The residents complained to the council about the unbearable noise.
complex.explanation: The residents complained + to the council + about the unbearable noise.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The residents complained to the council'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi penyesuaian modalitas pada reported speech lampau.
complex.draft: She said that she must finish the report by noon yesterday.
options: She said that she had had to finish the report by noon that day.
She said that she must to finish the report by noon that day.
She said that she have to finish the report by noon that day.
complex.explanation: Modal keharusan 'must' untuk kewajiban spesifik masa lalu bergeser menjadi 'had to' (atau had had to), dan 'yesterday' berubah menjadi 'that day' atau 'the previous day'.
hints: 'Must' untuk kewajiban lampau bergeser menjadi 'had to'.

complex.prompt: Indirect speech in journalistic writing often synthesizes multiple quotes into summary reporting verbs. Which verb implies reluctance in admitting truth?
complex.explanation: 'Concede' bermakna mengakui sesuatu yang benar secara enggan atau setelah perdebatan panjang.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog diplomatik dengan reported speech bersyarat.
dialogue: The minister stated that if tensions escalated, sanctions ___ immediately.
complex.explanation: Dalam reported speech, conditional clause bergeser: if + past simple (escalated), would + V1 ('would be applied').
hints: Klausa syarat bergeser ke masa lampau.

complex.prompt: Compare carefully: 'The minister ___ rumors that fuel subsidies would end' (firmly stated they are false) vs 'The committee ___ to reconsider the zoning rule' (declined/rejected a request).
complex.explanation: 'Deny/refute' digunakan untuk menyangkal pernyataan atau rumor ('membantah rumor'), sedangkan 'refuse/decline + to V1' digunakan untuk menolak melakukan sesuatu ('menolak meninjau ulang').
hints: Bedakan menyangkal kebenaran klaim ('deny/refute') vs menolak ajakan/permintaan ('refuse').

complex.prompt: Notice how journalistic style distinguishes certainty: 'The leaked memo ___ that quarterly layoffs are imminent' implies an unverified claim, whereas 'confirmed' treats it as established fact.
complex.explanation: Kata kerja pelapor jurnalistik seperti 'allege' dan 'claim' menjaga jarak netral penulis terhadap tuduhan atau pernyataan yang belum terbukti secara independen.
hints: Cari verb yang menunjukkan klaim sepihak yang belum terverifikasi.
'Allege' dan 'claim' menandakan penulis belum mengonfirmasi kebenarannya.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda tenses saat melaporkan First Conditional dengan sudut pandang lampau berikut.
complex.draft: Earlier this morning, the contractor warned us that if the concrete didn't arrive by noon, the crew will halt pouring.
options: Earlier this morning, the contractor warned us that if the concrete didn't arrive by noon, the crew would halt pouring.
Earlier this morning, the contractor warned us that if the concrete hadn't arrived by noon, the crew would halt pouring.
Earlier this morning, the contractor warned us that if the concrete doesn't arrive by noon, the crew would halt pouring.
complex.explanation: First Conditional ('If concrete doesn't arrive..., crew will halt...') ketika dilaporkan secara lampau ('warned us') memundurkan kedua klausa secara sejajar: 'didn't arrive' berpasangan dengan 'would halt'.
hints: Periksa konsistensi backshift di kedua bagian conditional.
Present Simple mundur ke Past Simple ('didn't arrive'), 'will' ke 'would'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik tentang konotasi verb pengutipan netral vs evaluatif.
dialogue: In your literature review, if you write 'Smith (2022) conceded that sample size was narrow', what stance does 'conceded' signal?
'Conceded' signals that Smith ___ despite perhaps wishing the data were broader.
options: reluctantly acknowledged a valid limitation or counter-point
angrily dismissed every critic without evidence
complex.explanation: Reporting verb evaluatif seperti 'concede' (mengakui dengan agak enggan poin kelemahan/argumen lawan) jauh lebih bernuansa daripada verb netral 'stated'.
hints: Pikirkan arti akademis kata 'concede' (= mengakui titik lemah atau argumen lawan).
Ini bukan verb netral ataupun pujian.

complex.prompt: The witness could remember little else, yet she clearly recalled ___ a blue van turn into the loading dock.
complex.explanation: Verb 'recall' (mengingat kembali peristiwa lampau) selalu diikuti gerund ('recalling seeing' / 'recalled seeing'), bukan to-infinitive.
hints: 'Recall' mengikuti pola yang sama dengan 'remember' untuk kenangan lampau.

complex.prompt: In reporting direct advice 'You really ought to back up the ledger', 'ought to' does NOT change form in backshift: 'He insisted that we ___ up the ledger.'
complex.explanation: Modal defektif 'ought to' (seperti 'should' dan 'might') tidak memiliki bentuk lampau lain dan tetap sama ('ought to + V1') dalam reported speech.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum menyisipkan 'that' sebelum kata tanya dalam reported question berikut.
complex.draft: The board asked the treasurer that how soon the municipal bonds would mature.
options: The board asked the treasurer how soon the municipal bonds would mature.
The board asked the treasurer that how soon would the municipal bonds mature.
The board asked to the treasurer how soon the municipal bonds would mature.
complex.explanation: Jangan pernah menggabungkan 'that' langsung sebelum kata tanya ('that how soon', 'that whether', 'that what') di dalam reported question; langsung gunakan 'how soon...' dengan urutan S+V.
hints: Hapus kata 'that' sebelum kata tanya 'how soon'.
Pastikan urutan pernyataan tetap S + would + V1.

complex.prompt: The compliance director urged that the subsidiary ___ any further payments pending investigation.
complex.explanation: Setelah 'urged that...', mandative subjunctive formal menggunakan bare infinitive 'suspend' tanpa '-s' meskipun subjeknya tunggal ('the subsidiary').
hints: Subjek tunggal 'the subsidiary' tetap memakai bentuk dasar tanpa '-s' di subjunctive.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat pelaporan jurnalistik dengan jarak kritis memakai 'alleged that'.
complex.targetSentence: Investigative reporters alleged that the contractor had submitted inflated mileage logs.
complex.explanation: 'Alleged that' menjaga netralitas jurnalis terhadap klaim yang belum divonis, diikuti Past Perfect 'had submitted'.
hints: Pasangkan klausa Past Perfect 'the contractor had submitted...'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat pengandaian tipe 1 yang sudah di-backshift dalam laporan.
complex.targetSentence: She promised that if the spare valve arrived early, mechanics would install it overnight.
complex.explanation: Present Simple ('arrives') dan 'will install' dimundurkan menjadi 'arrived' dan 'would install' setelah 'She promised'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'She promised that if the spare valve arrived early,'.
Lengkapi klausa hasil 'mechanics would install it overnight'.
